description: the version-blind check swallows no real drift: a manifest provenance line other than the generator version (here the crate) differing is KDLITH-GEN002 changed for the manifest, and one changed byte of a generated source file is changed for that file, each exiting 1

command: sed -i 's/^#@ crate parts-proc$/#@ crate other-proc/' out/kdlith-manifest && "$KDLITH_FX_KDLITH" gen schema inputs/schema.kdl --crate parts-proc --out out --kdlith-workspace --check; echo "exit=$?"
printf '\n' >> out/src/lib.rs && "$KDLITH_FX_KDLITH" gen schema inputs/schema.kdl --crate parts-proc --out out --kdlith-workspace --check; echo "exit=$?"
